{{Quote|&hellip;Lippinoss's servant Meeko&mdash;a Talz, one of those four-eyed folk.|Crev Bombaasa, a well-educated criminal|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Meeko''' was a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] who served as the servant of criminal [[Didina Lippinoss]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]], another criminal working for [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], one of Lippinoss's competitors, sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to meet with Meeko in the wilderness of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Bombaasa wished to blackmail Lippinoss with a dossier of incriminating information on her that he had compiled, but Meeko informed the spacer that Lippinoss would not deal with Bombaasa and sent the spacer back. Lippinoss subsequently hired a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to kill Bombaasa.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Meeko]]
Meeko's only appearance to date has been in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' where Meeko appears as a non-player character on Corellia. Due to the way such quests were designed by the developers, the appearance, gender and species of the NPC are different each time a player runs the mission. Therefore there's no canonical description of the character's look and gender, while Meeko's species is mentioned by Bombaasa and therefore canon.
